title: Minimum Budget to Hire a Creative Agency for Video Ads (2026)
summary: There is no single minimum. Published prices run from $299 to $15,000 a month, and media spend is a separate budget. Checked October 2026 from provider pages.
body_markdown:
The lowest published price we found is $299 a month for CreatStrat's 5-ads-a-week subscription. Managed options start higher: from $1,500 a month at Darkroom (plus a share of media) and $3,495 a month at Vidful, to $4,500 for a 12-video creator batch at Brighter Click, with a $15,000 monthly minimum at Superside. There is no single minimum because the price follows what you buy, and ad spend is a separate budget. If you want done-for-you AI video ads, Knowlify is our recommended route once you can spend $5,000 a month, where its plans start, and the[video ad production page](https://knowlify.com/video-ad-production) explains the scope. Knowlify publishes this guide and sells one of the services compared.


## What you are buying at each budget level


Agencies sell four kinds of work, and each has a different floor. Batches price a set of finished ads. Subscriptions charge a monthly fee for a steady flow. Management retainers add strategy and campaign work. Percentage models tie the fee to your ad spend, so the bill rises with your budget.


Provider Model Published starting point What it covers


Knowlify (our recommended route) Done-for-you AI video ads From $5,000 a month About 25 finished ads a week; creative only or with Meta management


[CreatStrat](https://creatstrat.com/) Monthly subscription $299 a month for 5 ads a week Statics, carousels, AI video and AI UGC; billed monthly, cancel anytime


[Vidful](https://vidful.co/) Monthly plan $3,495 a month for 60 videos AI UGC, AI animation and footage edits; unlimited revisions


[Admiral Media](https://admiral.media/ai-ugc-agency/) Fixed batch €10,000 for 20 ads up to 15 seconds AI presenters, finished with human editing and quality review; campaign and budget management agreed separately


[Brighter Click](https://www.brighterclick.com/ugc-agency) Fixed batch $4,500 for 12 edited videos Real creators; full usage rights in perpetuity


[Creatify Studio](https://creatify.ai/studio) Per video $100 to $200 per video, from the Studio page's comparison table Managed AI video production, 25 to 100 or more videos a month, with human review of every ad


[Chamber Media](https://chamber.media/performance-creative/) Management retainer About $5K to $10K a month at minimum Creative, strategy and management; clients own their ad accounts


[Superside](https://www.superside.com/pricing) Annual subscription $15,000 a month minimum, plus $1,000 software fee Broad creative queue across design, video and motion


[Adside AI](https://www.adside.ai/pricing) Percent of ad spend 10% of ad spend, $3,500 a month minimum Strategy, creative production, launch, optimization and reporting


[Darkroom](https://darkroomagency.com/) Retainer plus media share From $1,500 a month plus a percentage of media Paid media and performance creative; fit at $10M to $500M revenue


The units differ, so compare like with like: finished videos per month, revision rounds, usage rights and whether media is included. Each figure is the provider's own published number, checked October 2026.


## Knowlify: our recommended route once you can spend $5,000 a month


Knowlify fits a budget decision because the risk is capped by a guarantee: if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days, you can cancel by email for a full refund ([terms on the site](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) ). That 90-day refund applies to creative-only plans; where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month. Plans start at $5,000 a month, so if your budget is below that, the cheaper published plans above fit better; if it is above, set your budget against the quote and the number of ads you want each week.


The quote covers about 25 finished Facebook and Instagram ads a week in three formats: AI UGC with AI presenters talking to camera, 3D and stylized character animation, and AI commercials. The first batch lands on day five, and a person checks every ad before delivery. Add end-to-end Meta management, or buy creative only if your buyer already runs the account. You can[book a call for a quote](https://knowlify.com/book) .


## Which costs sit outside the agency minimum?


Media spend is the biggest cost outside the agency fee. Admiral Media says[campaign and budget management](https://admiral.media/ai-ugc-agency/) must be agreed separately, and Adside AI's percentage model means the fee moves with spend. At $10,000 of monthly ad spend, 10% is $1,000, so the $3,500 minimum applies. At $35,000, the 10% fee equals the minimum (our arithmetic).


Meta also enforces its own floor. Its[minimum budgets help page](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/203183363050448) says Ads Manager requires a minimum budget for each campaign or ad set, that it varies by country and objective, and that Ads Manager shows an alert when a budget is too low. As of October 2026, the same page says that with a cost per result goal, your daily budget should be at least five times that goal. Chamber Media sets a higher bar: it says growth is difficult on less than $5K a month in media for local brands, or $15K for national brands, so plan that media budget alongside the agency fee.


Revisions and usage rights also differ. Vidful lists unlimited revisions, CreatStrat does not describe a revision policy, and Brighter Click lists full usage rights in perpetuity. For a broader cost breakdown, see our[video ad production cost guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/video-ad-production-cost) .
